definition.tail: exactly one slash in each three-cell tail
definition.selection: slash position selects one consecutive three-cell body row
definition.selected_row: exactly one mark differs from the other two

provenance_caution: The one-exception criterion was introduced after row/column outputs had been inspected. Experiment 337 finds the qualitative row-survives/column-dies asymmetry in roughly one quarter of matched null permutations, so the discovery basis is weak/post-hoc. The family remains frozen only for holdout and prospective falsification; it must not be tuned further.

retrospective_null_calibration.evidentiary_status: weak retrospective discovery; prospective predictions remain frozen
